title: Stop! In the Name of Flaws: Disentangling Personal Names and Sociodemographic Attributes in NLP
reasoning: The paper is a critical overview and survey focused specifically on the ethical and methodological issues of using personal names for sociodemographic inference in NLP. It includes substantial sections on ethical concerns like representational harms, power dynamics, and cultural insensitivity, and it identifies religion as a key sociodemographic attribute often mishandled in this context.
